features.title: Schedules that fit families

aboutTitle: A second home where curiosity comes first
aboutText: We are a small, family-run centre for children aged 2 to 11. Our teachers know every child by name, celebrate small wins, and make learning feel like play.

programmes.title: Weekday daycare
programmes.text: Safe, nurturing care from Monday to Friday, with meals, rest, creative play and outdoor time built into the day.

programmes.title: Tuition classes
programmes.text: Small-group classes on weekends and weeknights in maths, English and science, taught through games and hands-on activities.

faqs.a: Daycare is for ages 2 to 9. Tuition classes are grouped by age, shown on each class.
Choose a class, send the form, and we confirm within one working day. Spots are held once confirmed.

faqs.q: Can we try a class first?
faqs.a: Yes. Ask for a trial session in the message box and we will arrange one when a spot is open.

faqs.q: What if a class is full?
faqs.a: Join the waitlist from the class and we will contact you as soon as a place opens.

faqs.q: What is included in daycare fees?
faqs.a: Supervised care, learning activities, snacks and lunch. Please tell us about any allergies when you enrol.
